name: Cairo
description: Egypt's sprawling capital on the banks of the Nile, where ancient history meets modern life. Home to the last surviving wonder of the ancient world, world-class museums, and a vibrant bazaar culture that has thrived for centuries.
popularActivities: Felucca ride at sunset on the Nile

name: Luxor
description: Once the ancient capital of Thebes, Luxor is an open-air museum unlike any other. The East Bank houses magnificent temples dedicated to Amun, while the West Bank conceals the Valley of the Kings — the eternal resting place of Egypt's pharaohs.
popularActivities: Hot-air balloon ride over the Valley of the Kings
Karnak Temple sound and light show

name: Aswan
description: Egypt's southernmost city rests on the granite rocks of the First Nile Cataract. A slower, more laid-back pace, Nubian villages painted in bright colours, the island temple of Philae, and the engineering marvel of the High Dam define this sun-drenched jewel.

name: Dubai
description: A city that rose from the desert in a single generation, Dubai dazzles with its record-breaking skyscrapers, artificial islands, and relentless ambition. Yet beneath the glitter lies a rich Emirati heritage visible in the historic creek and traditional souks.

name: Istanbul
description: The only city in the world that straddles two continents, Istanbul has served as the capital of three great empires — Roman, Byzantine, and Ottoman. Its skyline of minarets and domes, vibrant bazaars, and world-famous cuisine make it one of the great cities of the world.
popularActivities: Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque visit
Kadikoy morning market on the Asian side

name: London
description: One of the world's great global cities, London blends over 2,000 years of history with cutting-edge culture, cuisine, and fashion. From the Tower of London to the Tate Modern, from Notting Hill to Shoreditch, every neighbourhood tells a different story.
popularActivities: Tower Bridge and Tower of London
